rules.description: Ensure headline GDP, GVA, and state GSDP StatVars do not regress below 2026 and stay within MoSPI NAS annual publication lag.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS max_date_str FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_Nominal', 'Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_RealValue', 'Nominal_GrowthRate_Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction', 'RealValue_GrowthRate_Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction', 'Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossValueAdded_RealValue')
params.condition: max_date_str >= '2026' AND CAST(SUBSTR(max_date_str, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2

rules.description: Ensure all 34 production India NAS StatisticalVariables are emitted.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StatVar) AS sv_count FROM stats

rules.description: Ensure nominal GDP/GSDP retains country/IND plus all 34 Indian states and union territories.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, NumPlaces FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_Nominal'

rules.description: Ensure constant-price GDP/GSDP retains country/IND plus all 33 reporting states and union territories (including Puducherry).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, NumPlaces FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_RealValue'

rules.description: Ensure state GSDP growth rates retain all 33 reporting states and union territories.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, NumPlaces FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Nominal_GrowthRate_Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction', 'RealValue_GrowthRate_Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction')

rules.description: Ensure GDP, GVA, and GSDP monetary amounts in INR are non-negative (growth rates in Percent may be negative).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinValue FROM stats WHERE Units = 'INR'

rules.description: Ensure total emitted observations stay at or above the 2,825-row 2026-02-02 production baseline.

params.query: SELECT SUM(NumObservations) AS total_obs FROM stats
